exposure: Cockayne Syndrome Type B (CSB) classification (CS I, CS II, CS III)
outcome: clinical spectrum of Cockayne Syndrome Type B (CSB)
cohort: Eight patients with genetically confirmed Cockayne Syndrome Type B (CSB) caused by ERCC6 variants were included in the study.
finding: The study confirmed significant clinical variability in ERCC6/CSB, ranging from severe prenatal or neonatal onset to normal psychomotor development followed by progressive ataxia, and proposed sNFL as a useful peripheral biomarker reflecting disease severity.
